newsitem.title: USA: North American bunker fall amid ample supply.
newsitem.headline: North American bunker fall amid ample supply.

text.p: North American bunker prices fell late this week as several majors got resupplied on the East Coast and world prices continued to weaken, players said on Thursday.
Three major suppliers in New York Harbor who had been nearly empty last week all got cargoes at the same time making the market flush.

The resupply created a sort of panic selling in a market that looked like there may be more downward potential given the weakeness in the cargo market and prices in Amsterdam and European ports, players said.
